items.question: Is the robot arm in a collision-free and safe position?
Is the robot's gripper undamaged and able to open and close?
Are sensors providing reliable and consistent data?
Are there no hazardous objects or spilled materials in the workspace?
Are none of the cups knocked over or lying on their side?
Are all the cups located within the robot's reachable workspace?
Is there a clear, unobstructed path to all the cups?
Are all the cups on stable surfaces suitable for stacking?
Are all three cups fully stacked together?
Are all three cups completely separate from each other?
Are none of the cups knocked over or lying on their side?
